map.📖 四种胎压单位换算表: 📖 Conversion Table for Four Tire Pressure Units
map.行驶后胎温升高，胎压可比冷态高 0.2~0.3 bar（3~4 psi）。所有标: After driving the tire warms up and pressure can be 0.2~0.3 bar (3~4 psi) higher than cold. All reference values mean cold tires (parked over 3 hours or driven less than 2km).
map.便携气泵多显示 psi 或 bar，加油站的数显充气机可能显示 kPa。换算后再: Portable inflators usually read psi or bar, while digital air machines at gas stations may read kPa. Convert before inflating so 2.3bar is never taken as 2.3psi or 230psi.
map.💡 单位换算只解决读数口径，具体该充多少仍须以本车车门框标贴或手册建议值为准。: 💡 Unit conversion only reconciles readings; how much to inflate still follows the door-jamb label or owner's manual.
map.按车门标签的标准胎压，在 bar、psi、kPa、kg/cm² 之间换算，适配不: Convert the standard pressure on the door label between bar, psi, kPa and kg/cm² to match whatever gauge you have.
map.美规车型标注 psi、欧系标注 bar，借换设备时快速统一读数避免充错。: US-spec cars list psi and European cars bar; unify readings quickly when borrowing equipment to avoid charging wrong.
map.重载或高速长途前，把建议值换算后核对随身打气泵的单位显示。: Before heavy loads or long highway trips, convert the recommended value and check the unit shown on your portable inflator.
map.车门标签前轮标准 2.3bar；1bar=14.5038psi，故 2.3bar: Door label front axle standard 2.3bar; with 1bar=14.5038psi, 2.3bar≈33.4psi (usually 33psi); 1bar=100kPa, hence 230kPa; 1bar≈1.02kg/cm², about 2.35kg/cm². Inflate to this value on cold tires.
map.冷胎和热胎读数差多少？: How much do cold and hot readings differ?
map.行驶后胎温升高，胎压可比冷态高 0.2–0.3bar（3–4psi），因此标准值: After driving the tire warms up and pressure can be 0.2–0.3bar (3–4psi) above cold, so reference values always mean cold tires (parked 3+ hours or driven <2km). Inflating a hot tire to the cold value leaves it too low once cooled, so always set pressure from a cold reading.
map.前后轮胎压为什么要不同？: Why do front and rear tire pressures differ?
map.前驱车前置发动机重、前轮承载大，前轮常比后轮高 0.1–0.3bar；满载或高速: Front-wheel-drive cars carry the engine up front, so the front axle loads more and often runs 0.1–0.3bar higher than the rear; raise rear pressure accordingly when carrying full load or cruising fast. Follow the door label, which already gives front/rear values based on weight distribution.
map.标准胎压指冷胎读数，热胎测量值偏高 0.2~0.3bar 属正常: Reference pressure means a cold reading; a hot measurement 0.2~0.3bar higher is normal
